verdicts.reason: Both have the same serious flaws. The MONOGRAPH logo is shrunk to an unreadable speck and dropped awkwardly at the base of the watch, which is a brand failure. The price also sits above 'Field Watch No. 2', so the original reading order is reversed. The watch hugs the left edge, leaving a large dead gap. A pushes the Shop button out to the far right edge, cut off from its copy. B moves Shop closer to the price/title block, which groups the CTA better, so B is slightly less bad.
